address: 1F, The Terrace, 126 Oxford Terrace, Christchurch Central City, Christchurch, 8011, New Zealand
bio: With front-row views of the Avon River and lush greenery, the light-filled room fosters a welcoming, unhurried feel and is perfect for get-togethers with friends. The menu puts Mediterranean gastronomy centre stage, flaunting pronounced Spanish and Middle Eastern accents. In addition to wood-fired seafood and smoked meats and vegetables, try their house-made Nduja sausage – grilled over a wood fire, it boasts a snappy crust and smoky, spicy flavours.
